annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 of 26 January 2021 on harmonised standards for lifts and safety components for lifts drafted in support of Directive 2014/33/EU
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 of 26 January 2021 on harmonised standards for lifts and safety components for lifts drafted in support of Directive 2014/33/EU
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision publishing references of harmonised standards for lifts and lift safety components under Directive 2014/33/EU, including revised EN 81-20:2020 and EN 81-50:2020, giving presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes references of harmonised lift standards listed in Annex I in the Official Journal
Repeals Communication 2016/C 293/64, which continues to apply until 27 July 2022 for EN 81-20:2014 and EN 81-50:2014
Conformity with the standards presumes compliance with essential health and safety requirements of Directive 2014/33/EU
Enters into force on the day of publication
